proposals.evidence: Turner *channi covering explicitly records Bihari chānh/chānhī/chānhiyā thatch roof, Old Awadhi chāna and Punjabi chann thatched roof. These central/eastern survey roof responses fit that noun family, with deaspiration and local ch/s spellings retained. The link is a regional comparative assignment; channa 4989 is related but separately represented.
